_about: Tool map for the Playwright MCP server, used by the write gate. Any tool on this server that is not listed is denied. Checked against @playwright/mcp 0.0.85 and 0.0.86 (same tool list, 2026-11-26). Tools that reveal session tokens are asked, not allowed (security review 2026-11-26).

ask_reasons.browser_evaluate: runs your own JavaScript inside the app page
ask_reasons.browser_file_upload: sends a file from this computer to the app
ask_reasons.browser_route: fakes or blocks the app's network traffic
ask_reasons.browser_unroute: changes the app's network traffic rules
ask_reasons.browser_network_state_set: switches the browser offline or online
ask_reasons.browser_webmcp_call: calls a tool the web page offers
ask_reasons.browser_storage_state: reads or saves the login session (cookies and tokens)
ask_reasons.browser_network_request: shows a full request, including login headers
ask_reasons.browser_cookie_get: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens
ask_reasons.browser_cookie_list: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens
ask_reasons.browser_localstorage_get: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens
ask_reasons.browser_localstorage_list: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens
ask_reasons.browser_sessionstorage_get: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens
ask_reasons.browser_sessionstorage_list: reads stored login data (cookies or storage), which can contain session tokens

deny_reasons.browser_run_code_unsafe: runs arbitrary Playwright code outside the page; ReconQA skills never need it
deny_reasons.browser_install: installs software; install the browser yourself
